_doc: Known answers for the 2026-10-21 QC audit (tests/test_imagine_qc_audit.py): per film, the per-frame continuity and the hands on every third frame, measured by scripts/imagine-qc-measure.py's own continuity() and hands_on() (MediaPipe hand landmarker float16/1). Numbers only. `answer` says what the film is.

synthetic-hard-cut.answer: a 2 s jump inside one shot of Bash's work loop: a cut

synthetic-black-2.answer: 2 black frames in Bash's work loop

synthetic-splice-6.answer: 6 frames of another film spliced in

synthetic-still-15.answer: one frame held 15 s (what intake.still_clip makes)
